decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera closely aligned with the firm's core space-grade optical navigation and observation business and already given a dedicated product page, it is likely to be retained while market adoption builds.
The modular space navigation camera fits the firm's stated strategic direction toward more flexible and adaptable spacecraft sensors, so management would likely continue supporting it.
Although slightly more adjacent than the camera products, the sensor suite still builds on established capabilities and was visibly promoted, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor matches the firm's push toward compact future spacecraft instruments, but the weaker website prominence suggests a somewhat higher chance of reprioritization than for the other launches.
